method: Focused independent reconsideration of original packet and supplied graph witnesses. No mapping or other audit read. Material error requires evidence excluding reasonable context-limited interpretation; ambiguous phrasing alone is not a demonstrated added prohibition.

adjudications.quote: 重新產生或修改既有匯出檔
adjudications.reason: Object is existing export files, not every future output. Recreating/replacing those existing files is naturally encompassed by preserving them. A separate-output regeneration method ban is possible but not demonstrably intended. Original audit inferred too much from the word regeneration.
adjudications.retained_ambiguity: Could be read more broadly than do not rewrite existing files; use original boundary to avoid ambiguity.
adjudications.clarity_status: Graph composition fails independent verification; recorded separately below, not a factual scope defect.

adjudications.decision: retain as ambiguity, no demonstrated material error
adjudications.quote: No other text in SETUP.md changes, and no other file changes.
adjudications.reason: Read literally as an unrestricted repository invariant, it conflicts with the saved mandatory intent. In task context, it can reasonably mean only the requested implementation/documentation source line changes while workflow records are separate. Reply openly discloses the draft; there is no attempt to claim no file was written. Source request itself says only this one line, so a context-limited acceptance does not clearly enlarge scope.
adjudications.retained_ambiguity: Acceptance does not explicitly exclude required workflow records. This should not be counted as a proven failure without evidence of literal enforcement or broader intended ban.

adjudications.decision: retain as low-severity wording ambiguity, no material error
adjudications.quote: 目前發票列表已能依客戶與日期篩選，但沒有下載資料的功能。
adjudications.reason: The immediately surrounding context is monthly copying from the invoice list and the next Proposed outcome explicitly specifies downloading filtered CSV. Reading this as no CSV download is reasonable shorthand. Literal absence of any other download format is unsupported, but the whole artifact does not demonstrably assert or rely on that broader claim.
adjudications.retained_ambiguity: Could replace shorthand with absence of CSV action; do not count as proven unsupported broad product capability absence.

adjudications.decision: retain material issue, narrow anchor to author-declared unresolved required content
quotes: 有兩個價值面的資訊你還沒提供,我先列在草稿的未決問題裡,不自己猜:
你回答之後,我才會把草稿改成已確認。
以上這份需求是你要的嗎?
adjudications.reason: Monthly recurrence can supply concrete urgency; absent exact deadline is not automatically a weak urgency answer. One weak displaced-work answer can coexist with GO. Therefore GO itself is not the error. The author nevertheless explicitly declares two missing items as unresolved Open questions that must be answered before confirmation, while presenting ready five-section confirmation and requesting confirmation now. The unchanged owner rule says missing required content keeps interview open and blocks confirmation preparation. If these questions are optional, they should not be represented as blocking required Open questions.
not_claimed: No assumption that urgency necessarily lacks evidence.
No claim that open status alone conflicts with GO.
No claim that writing an open draft is already confirmation.
